comment: Invoker IAM for the IAM-private production Cloud Run service in production-service.template.yaml. The infrastructure tooling renders the placeholders by text substitution and applies the policy; nothing in the repository applies it. The service policy holds exactly one binding: roles/run.invoker for the edge invoker service account and, only when VERIFIER_SA renders non-empty, the verifier service account. Neither account holds any project role. production-edge-infra.check.mjs validates this file.
